statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ remains rotational near prior settlement; extreme energy, volatility and geopolitical stress has not yet produced persistent no-retracement structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold; the next concentrated structure checkpoint is the U.S. cash open through the Dallas Fed release.
headline: NQ rotation keeps Tail at WATCH while oil and geopolitical Stress remain extreme
body: Delayed NQ was 29,493.50 at 05:29:33 ET, essentially unchanged from the 29,491.75 prior close after a 29,409.75–29,533.75 session range. The retreat from the European-session high remains meaningful. Brent above $90, firmer volatility and renewed U.S.-Iran escalation keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail held at 19% through 20:00 UTC on August 30, rose with renewed U.S.-Iran escalation, peaked at 30% at 01:00 UTC, then eased as overnight and European price action rotated. It briefly returned to 26% at 08:00 before falling to 23% at 09:00 as NQ retraced toward prior settlement.
outlookSummary: Tail is 23% WATCH because the European-session high did not persist and delayed NQ is back near prior settlement. Baseline path risk eases with continued two-sided trade; the U.S. cash open and 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed release are the next concentrated checkpoints while geopolitical, oil and rate Stress remains extreme.

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open and 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed release form the day's tightest checkpoint. Tail reaches upper WATCH only if opening-auction direction and any data repricing align into repeated extension with weak pullbacks.

After the Dallas Fed release, Tail depends on the observed repricing path. Quick rotation would preserve WATCH, while sustained extension after failed pullbacks would be the condition for a higher band.
If the first ninety minutes of U.S. cash trading remain two-sided, Tail eases further. Persistent near-extreme holding would be the main condition that prevents that normalization.
If cash-session breadth and semiconductors fail to align with oil and rates into one direction, conflicting cross-assets keep Stress high but restrain Tail.
Mid-session Tail stays near the WATCH floor if retracements continue to clear prior extensions. Headline volatility alone does not imply persistent mean-reversion failure.
If the afternoon range remains balanced, Tail holds near the low end of WATCH. A fresh directional catalyst would need follow-through rather than a single impulse to lift the score.
As liquidity thins into late afternoon, Tail edges up slightly because a late range break can travel farther. Meaningful counter-moves would keep the path inside WATCH.
Power hour carries a conditional Tail pickup if the cash session begins holding near an extreme with repeated extension. A closing rotation would keep the score below the block threshold.
After the U.S. cash close, Tail falls if the closing move does not extend into futures. Geopolitical headlines can keep Stress high without establishing a one-way price path.
If post-close futures remain rotational, Tail stays near the WATCH floor. A renewed oil or geopolitical shock would matter mainly through whether NQ begins extending without retracement.
Late U.S. evening risk remains conditional on headline transmission. Tail stays contained if price continues to mean-revert inside the established broader range.
Into the Asia handoff, Tail remains near WATCH if the prior U.S. range is respected. A gap-like repricing with shallow retracements would be the condition for renewed elevation.
Early Asia can reprice unresolved geopolitical headlines, but Tail remains contained unless the move becomes persistently directional and holds near a session extreme.
If early Asia develops two-sided trade after any opening impulse, Tail remains around WATCH. Cross-asset volatility continues to support elevated Stress rather than automatic Tail escalation.
If Asian price discovery remains orderly and retracements are meaningful, Tail can move below WATCH even while macro and geopolitical uncertainty stays elevated.
A stable Asian mid-session with no fresh session-extreme persistence keeps Tail low. New headlines would require observed follow-through before changing the path assessment.
If the Asian session remains contained into its later hours, Tail stays low as the market continues to demonstrate mean-reverting structure rather than directional efficiency.
European pre-open liquidity can widen moves, so Tail returns to WATCH conditionally if range boundaries are tested. The score stays below block absent shallow-pullback continuation.
At the European cash open, Tail rises within WATCH if the opening impulse tests an overnight extreme. Reversal back through the opening range would reduce the persistence signal.
If the European opening move carries into the second hour with weak retracements, Tail remains elevated within WATCH. Clear rotation would keep the path below the blocking threshold.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed NQ has retraced from the European-session high back near prior settlement, keeping Tail at WATCH despite extreme cross-asset stress.
Continued settlement-area rotation would ease Tail; a renewed high break with shallow counter-moves would reverse that path.
Range containment and repeated retracements would keep Tail near the lower WATCH boundary.
U.S. premarket liquidity can raise path risk if a range break begins surviving meaningful pullbacks.
Cash open plus the 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed release is the tightest checkpoint; only persistent extension would justify a block.
Post-release Tail depends on whether price rotates or extends after failed pullbacks.
